title: Adapter
description: Per-implementation bridge from the tournament-protocol wire format to a candidate executable. The candidate reads one JSON object on stdin and writes one JSON value on stdout (tstournament protocol). v2 amendment 2026-05-23 (bead 3u3): added optional `tool_flags` for queryable head/precision dispatch on tools like special-eval.

capability_id.description: The benchmark suite this adapter grades — one adapter per (target, suite) pair.

cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned process. ${WORKBENCH_ROOT} is substituted to the SCIENTIST_WORKBENCH env var.

version.description: Recorded into grade_runs.candidate_version. Not pinned by the corpus; the user updates when re-running.

platform_pinned.description: If true, grade-runs record the platform fingerprint {arch, os, runtime} (ADR-0015 alignment with scientist-workbench numerical tier).

tool_flags.description: Structured key/value flags for head-dispatched tools (e.g. {"head": "BesselJ", "precision": "53"}); queryable from DuckDB without parsing args[].
tool_flags.$comment: Added by bead 3u3 (2026-05-23) for downstream consumers B14 (special-eval adapter), B18 (erf-anchor), B19 (besselj-anchor); see ADR-0040 (special-eval umbrella). Purely additive and optional — existing 26 adapters validate unchanged.
